All tools/Word to PDF

Word to PDF

Preview a DOCX document and download it as a PDF.

Supports .docx, not legacy .doc. Complex layouts may differ from Microsoft Word. The PDF is image-based: text is not selectable. Review the preview before downloading.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Choose a DOCX document. Legacy DOC files are not supported.
  2. Wait for the document preview, then check every page.
  3. Download the PDF. Text is stored as page images.

Good to know

What should I expect?

Conversion happens on your device. DOCX layout is rendered in an isolated preview and exported as page images. Fonts, equations, floating objects, complex tables, headers and page breaks may differ. Use Microsoft Word export for exact Office fidelity. Maximum 30 rendered pages and 100 MB expanded DOCX content.

Are my files uploaded?

No. Files stay in your browser. No file content is sent to a server.
